in_english.name: Khayr
in_english.long_meaning: Khayr is an Arabic name that means goodness, good, benevolence, charity, welfare. It is derived from the Arabic root 'khy-r' which connotes the idea of goodness and righteousness. In Islamic tradition, Khayr is considered a name that reflects positive qualities such as kindness, generosity, and compassion. The name has historical significance in Islamic culture and is associated with virtues like charity and welfare

data.cultural_impact: The name "Khayr" is of Arabic origin and is a common name in the Islamic world, particularly in countries like Pakistan, India, Egypt, and Saudi Arabia. The name "Khayr" has a positive meaning in the Arabic language and culture, as it signifies doing good, showing kindness, and being blessed. People with this name are often seen as generous, selfless, and compassionate individuals. The name is also associated with good fortune, prosperity, and success.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Islamic faith, the name "Khayr" holds significant spiritual significance as it is mentioned in the Quran several times. For instance, in Surah Al-Falaq, Allah (God) is asked to protect us from the evil that he has created and to grant us the Khayr (goodness) which He has promised. Similarly, in Surah Al-Inshirah, Allah promises Khayr (goodness) and forgiveness to those who believe and do good deeds. The name also reflects the fundamental Islamic values of kindness, generosity, and compassion towards others. Muslims who carry the name "Khayr" are expected to live up to its spiritual significance by striving to do good deeds, being kind and compassionate to others, and seeking Allah's blessings and mercy.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Good, Blessed" symbolizes Doing good, being blessed. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Khayr serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of good, blessed.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Al-Khayr ibn Abd al-Rahman was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Khayr carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Al-Khayr was a prominent figure in early Islamic history and is known for his generosity and kindness.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Khayr remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.

name_in_real_life.story: Aisha Khayr, a teacher in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, shares that their name Khayr meaning "Good, Blessed" has been a source of inspiration throughout their life, motivating them to be a positive influence in their community.
